arxiv-2203-03167.title: Comparison of evolving interfaces, triple points, and quadruple points for discrete and diffuse interface methods
arxiv-2203-03167.creator: Erdem Eren, Brandon Runnels, Jeremy Mason
arxiv-2203-03167.description: Abstract The evolution of interfaces is intrinsic to many physical processes ranging from cavitation in fluids to recrystallization in solids. Computational modeling of interface motion entails a number of challenges, many of which are related to the range of topological transitions that can occur over the course of the simulation.

arxiv-2211-01854.title: Ultralight dark matter searches at the sub-Hz frontier with atom multigradiometry
arxiv-2211-01854.creator: and Jeremiah Mitchell
arxiv-2211-01854.description: Abstract Single-photon atom gradiometry is a powerful experimental technique that can be employed to search for the oscillation of atomic transition energies induced by ultralight scalar dark matter (ULDM). In the sub-Hz regime, the background is expected to be dominated by gravity gradient noise (GGN), which arises as a result of mass fluctuations around the experiment.

arxiv-2301-13158.title: Selection principles and proofs from the Book

arxiv-2301-13158.description: Abstract . I provide simplified proofs for each of the following fundamental theorems regarding selection principles: (1) The Quasinormal Convergence Theorem, due to the author and Zdomskyy, asserting that a certain, important property of the space of continuous functions on a space is actually preserved by Borel images of that space.

arxiv-2302-07109.title: Reachability-Based Confidence-Aware Probabilistic Collision Detection in Highway Driving
arxiv-2302-07109.creator: Xinwei Wang, Zirui Li, Javier Alonso-Mora, Meng Wang
arxiv-2302-07109.description: Abstract Abstract: Risk assessment is a crucial component of collision warning and avoidance systems in intelligent vehicles. To accurately detect potential vehicle collisions, reachability-based formal approaches have been developed to ensure driving safety, but suffer from over-conservatism, potentially leading to false-positive risk events in complicated real-world applications. arxiv-2401-16918.title: On egalitarian values for cooperative games with a priori unions
arxiv-2401-16918.creator: J.M. Alonso-Meijide, J. Costa, I. García-Jurado, J.C. Gonçalves-Dosantos
arxiv-2401-16918.description: Abstract In this paper we extend the equal division and the equal surplus division values for transferable utility cooperative games to the more general setup of transferable utility cooperative games with a priori unions. In the case of the equal surplus division value we propose three possible extensions. We provide axiomatic characterizations of the new values.

arxiv-2404-10364.title: Quantum Gravity in Flat Spacetime
arxiv-2404-10364.creator: Jarmo Mäkelä
arxiv-2404-10364.description: Abstract Inspired by Einstein’s Strong Principle of Equivalence we consider the effects of quantum mechanics to the gravity-like phenomena experienced by an observer in a uniformly accelerating motion in flat spacetime. Among other things, our model of quantum gravity, derived from the first principles, predicts the Unruh effect, and a discrete area spectrum for spacelike two-surfaces.

arxiv-2407-07312.title: Hybrid Synchronization with Continuous Varying Exponent in Decentralized Power Grid Journal: Chaos, Solitons and Fractals
arxiv-2407-07312.creator: Jinha Park, B. Kahng
arxiv-2407-07312.description: Abstract Motivated by the decentralized power grid, we consider a synchronization transition (ST) of the Kuramoto model (KM) with a mixture of first- and second-order type oscillators with fractions p p and 1 − p 1-p , respectively. Discontinuous ST with forward-backward hysteresis is found in the mean-field limit.

arxiv-2504-02432.title: Robust Randomized Low-Rank Approximation with Row-Wise Outlier Detection
arxiv-2504-02432.creator: Aidan Tiruvan
arxiv-2504-02432.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Aidan Tiruvan. We present a method for robust randomized low-rank approximation in the presence of row-wise adversarial corruption, a setting where an α \alpha -fraction of the rows in a data matrix can deviate substantially from the majority.

arxiv-2505-14023.title: Concave transforms of compactified S S -metrized divisors
arxiv-2505-14023.creator: Debam Biswas, Yulin Cai
arxiv-2505-14023.description: Abstract . We associate a concave transform to any compactified S S -metrized divisor on a quasi-projective variety over an adelic curve. Then we show a Hilbert-Samuel type formula for relatively nef compactified S S -metrized YZ \mathrm{YZ} -divisors. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 14G40; Secondary 11G50 1. arxiv-2601-15294.title: KnowTeX: Visualizing Mathematical Dependencies
arxiv-2601-15294.creator: Elif Uskuplu, Lawrence S. Moss, Valeria de Paiva
arxiv-2601-15294.description: Abstract Mathematical knowledge exists in many forms, ranging from informal textbooks and lecture notes to large formal proof libraries, yet moving between these representations remains difficult. Informal texts hide dependencies, while formal systems expose every detail in ways that are not always human-readable. Dependency graphs offer a middle ground by making visible the structure of results, definitions, and proofs.

arxiv-2602-09182.title: One RNG to Rule Them All: How Randomness Becomes an Attack Vector in Machine Learning
arxiv-2602-09182.creator: Kotekar Annapoorna Prabhu, Andrew Gan, Zahra Ghodsi
arxiv-2602-09182.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Kotekar Annapoorna Prabhu, Andrew Gan, Zahra Ghodsi. Machine learning relies on randomness as a fundamental component in various steps such as data sampling, data augmentation, weight initialization, and optimization. Most machine learning frameworks use pseudorandom number generators as the source of randomness. However, variations in design choices and implementations across different frameworks, software dependencies, and hardware backends along with the lack of statistical validation can lead to previously unexplored attack vectors on machine learning systems.

pmc-10579986.title: MicroRNA‑27a‑3p regulates the proliferation and chemotaxis of pulmonary macrophages in non‑small cell lung carcinoma tissues through CXCL2
pmc-10579986.creator: Congying Zhai, Baoliang Liu, Fanggong Kan, Shuhui Zhai, Ronghua Zhang
pmc-10579986.description: The present study aimed to investigate microRNA (miRNA)-27a-3p expression in the pulmonary macrophages and peripheral blood of patients with early non-small cell lung carcinoma (NSCLC) and its regulatory effect on the infiltration of pulmonary macrophages into cancer tissues and invasion of NSCLC cells. Blood specimens were withdrawn from 36 patients with NSCLC and 29 healthy subjects.

pmc-11356061.title: Relationship between SLAP Lesions and Shoulder Joint Capsule Thickness: An MR Arthrographic Study
pmc-11356061.creator: Derya Güçlü, Veysel Uludağ, Mehmet Arıcan, Elif Nisa Ünlü, Hayri Oğul
pmc-11356061.description: Background and Objectives: This study aimed to evaluate the relationship between SLAP lesions and the shoulder joint capsule thickness via MR arthrography. Understanding the relationship between SLAP lesions and the joint capsule thickness is important because an increased capsule thickness may indicate chronic inflammation and contribute to persistent pain and dysfunction.

pmc-11599589.title: Ultra-wideband microstrip folded antenna for wireless LAN, 5G and Internet of Things applications
pmc-11599589.creator: Utkarsh Pandey, Parulpreet Singh, Raghvendra Singh, Vivek Kumar, Kanad Ray, Saurav Mallik, Haya Mesfer Alshahrani, E Elshiekh, Mohamed Abbas, Ben Othman Soufiene
pmc-11599589.description: This paper presents an ultra-wideband (UWB) microstrip antenna with a simple structure operating at 2.2–6 GHz bandwidth. The proposed antenna has been demonstrated for its suitability in UWB and multi-band applications, such as wireless local area network (WLAN), Wi-Fi, 5G, Internet of Things (IoT), etc.

pmc-11672994.title: Optimizing Recovery of High-Added-Value Compounds from Complex Food Matrices Using Multivariate Methods
pmc-11672994.creator: Yixuan Liu, Basharat N. Dar, Hilal A. Makroo, Raouf Aslam, Francisco J. Martí-Quijal, Juan M. Castagnini, Jose Manuel Amigo, Francisco J. Barba
pmc-11672994.description: In today’s food industry, optimizing the recovery of high-value compounds is crucial for enhancing quality and yield. Multivariate methods like Response Surface Methodology (RSM) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) play key roles in achieving this. This review compares their technical strengths and examines their sustainability impacts, highlighting how these methods support greener food processing by optimizing resources and reducing waste.

pmc-11738490.title: Fitness to Drive Policy in Inpatient Setting: Findings of QI Project
pmc-11738490.creator: Sajid Mahmood, Heba Radwan, Omotilewa Omotoso, Waqqas Khokhar, Nosheen Shams
pmc-11738490.description: AimsBackground: Nature and degree of mental illness can impair abilities of patients to drive safely which puts their own safety and safety of others at risk. There is also an ongoing concern of patients not being properly informed on their duty to inform the DVLA and potentially to stop driving for an extended period.

pmc-12564559.title: Description of T-Cell and Monocyte Populations in the Circulation of People with HIV Prior to AIDS-NHL Diagnosis
pmc-12564559.creator: Laura E. Martínez, Begoña Comin-Anduix, Miriam Güemes-Aragon, Javier Ibarrondo, Roger Detels, Matthew J. Mimiaga, Marta Epeldegui
pmc-12564559.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). People with HIV (PWH) are at an increased risk for AIDS-associated non-Hodgkin lymphoma (AIDS-NHL); however, the immune signatures underlying this risk are not well understood. In this study, we utilized mass cytometry by time-of-flight (CyTOF) to analyze T-cells and monocytes in the PBMCs of treatment-naïve PWH, including those 3 to 36 months before an AIDS-NHL diagnosis (HIV-positive pre-NHL), as well as people without HIV (PWoH). Mass cytometry is an advanced single-cell analysis platform that combines flow cytometry principles with mass spectrometry.

pmc-13211564.title: Genomic Diversity of Vaginal Lactobacillus crispatus Prophages from South African Women
pmc-13211564.creator: Adijat Ozohu Jimoh, Anika Chicken, Brandon Maust, Colin Feng, Seth Rakoff-Nahoum, Jo-Ann S. Passmore, Brian R. Kullin, Simona Kraberger, Fatima Aysha Hussain, Heather B. Jaspan, Arvind Varsani, Anna-Ursula Happel
pmc-13211564.description: Lactobacillus crispatus is widely associated with optimal sexual and reproductive health outcomes. While L. crispatus genomes commonly harbor prophages, little is known about their genomic diversity and potential inducibility by clinically relevant compounds. We induced and characterized four bacteriophages from four L. crispatus strains isolated from vaginal secretions of South African adolescents.

pmc-13578263.title: Lignin-dynamic networks break the strength–toughness trade-off in thermoplastic elastomers
pmc-13578263.creator: Peng Zhao, Tianwei Wu, Jinsong Sun, Meng Liu, Qi Tang, Zechun Ren, Yongzhuang Liu, Haipeng Yu
pmc-13578263.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The long-standing trade-off between strength and toughness has constrained the performance of thermoplastic elastomers. Here, we address this challenge by constructing a three-dimensional supramolecular network in a thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer via dynamic chain extension with lignin polyols. Unlike conventional linear or branched extenders, lignin’s rigid aromatic backbone and abundant hydroxyl groups serve as multifunctional nodes that simultaneously enhance microphase separation and establish a hierarchical, dynamic hydrogen-bonding network.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. A commission to be known as the Migratory Bird Conservation Commission, consisting of the Secretary of the Interior, as chairman, the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, the Secretary of Agriculture and two Members of the Senate.
